items.takeaway: Review one list at 9 AM instead of checking four tools all day.
items.voiceScript: Stop checking four tools for new leads. Build one daily n eight n digest. Read new enquiries, normalize the fields, rank the obvious buying signals, and send one morning brief. Start with rules you can explain. Add A I only for the ambiguous messages later. You get one list at nine A M and fewer missed opportunities. The free starter templates are in my bio.
